content_sections.heading: IARI Young Professional Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility depends on the post and the entry number applied for. The general conditions in the notification are listed below. Qualification and experience requirements for each entry are given in the next section. Only candidates having the essential qualifications will be entertained for the online interview. The maximum age is 45 years for YP-II/YP-I and 35 years for PA-II/PA, with relaxations as given in the age limit section. Candidates must compulsorily fill the application form strictly as per the annexed format and enclose all required documents. Candidates who are currently working shall bring a No Objection Certificate from their employer (the notification states this for entry 1 and again after the salary details). If any near or distant relative of a candidate is an employee of ICAR-IARI, the candidate must declare the relative's name, designation, nature of duties and relationship in writing, so as to reach by 31 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: IARI Young Professional Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification describes the selection steps as follows. Candidates send their application in the prescribed Performa, with self-attested scanned documents, to the AAO (Environmental Sciences) by email. Applications are screened. Eligible candidates shortlisted based on project work requirement are called by email for the online interview. The online interview is tentatively fixed for the first week of November 2026. Details and reporting time will be communicated by email, and all candidates shall adhere to the instructions. Original documents will be verified at the time of appointment. Selected candidates must also produce a medical certificate at the time of joining. The notification does not mention a written test, marks distribution or a merit list.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for IARI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: As per the terms and conditions, the following must be sent by email by 31 October 2026: Application form, filled strictly as per the annexed format (Annexure I) Self-attested scanned certificates from X class onwards Date of birth certificate NET/equivalent certificate Bachelor's and master's degree certificates or provisional certificates A recent photograph Proof of experience and publications Written declaration regarding relatives employed at ICAR-IARI (as per the declaration format), to reach by 31 October 2026 Failure to submit the required documents along with the application will lead to rejection of the application, and no further communication will be entertained on this matter.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IARI Young Professional Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Read the notification and check the essential qualification for the entry number you want to apply for. Fill the application form given in Annexure I, indicating the post(s) applied for with the entry number(s). Attach the self-attested scanned documents listed above, along with a recent passport size photograph. Complete the declaration about relatives employed in ICAR/IARI. Email the application and documents to [email protected] on or before 31 October 2026. Wait for an email about the online interview if you are shortlisted. Contact number given in the notification: 011-25846359.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the ICAR Indian Agricultural Research Institute (ICAR IARI), New Delhi, for various contractual research positions under various ongoing projects.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in ICAR IARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions include Young Professional-II (YP-II), Young Professional-I (YP-I), Project Associate-II (PA-II), and Project Assistant (PA) across different specialized disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: There are a total of 20 vacancies distributed across multiple specialized research posts and projects at ICAR IARI, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed application form along with required documents via email is 31st October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for ICAR IARI Jobs?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to send their scanned applications and supporting self-attested documents via email to the designated official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit for YP-II and YP-I posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Young Professional-II and Young Professional-I posts is 45 years, with permissible age relaxations for reserved categories as per rules.

faq.question: Q7. What qualifications are needed for Project Associate-II?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MSc, MTech, ME, or MCA degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Atmospheric Science, Geomatics, Geo-informatics, AI/ML, Data Science, or related fields.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary for Young Professional-II?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Young Professional-II (YP-II) positions will receive a fixed consolidated salary of Rs. 42,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves initial screening of the received applications followed by an online interview conducted by the selection committee.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the application be emailed?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to the AAO (Environmental Sciences) via e-mail at [email protected] on or before the specified deadline.
